body.name: bounded-alphabet empirical-ratio fallback
body.construction: Let \(\overline N_x=\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbf 1\{X_i=x\}\), \(\overline N_{ax}=\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbf 1\{X_i=x,A_i=a\}\), and \(\overline S_{ax}=\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbf 1\{X_i=x,A_i=a,Y_i=1\}\). Put \(\widehat p_x=\overline N_x/n\), \(\widehat\mu_{ax}=\overline S_{ax}/\overline N_{ax}\) with \(0/0=0\), and \(\widehat V_{n,d}^{\mathrm{ER}}=\sum_{x=1}^d\widehat p_x\max_a\widehat\mu_{ax}\).
